overview: Self-hosted AI workspace for building, running, and collaborating with agents across multiple LLM providers.
description:
LobeHub (formerly LobeChat) is an open-source, self-hosted AI workspace for working with large language models and agents. It provides a unified interface for multiple model providers, plugins and skills, knowledge bases, and team collaboration.

This package deploys the official LobeHub server with bundled PostgreSQL, Redis, and S3-compatible object storage (RustFS), following the upstream server deployment model. Users register and sign in directly in the web interface.

Typical use cases include personal AI assistants, multi-model chat, team agent workspaces, retrieval-augmented knowledge bases, and self-hosted alternatives to hosted AI chat platforms.
